companyFieldUpdates.description: Montecito Medical Outpatient Portfolio is the bounded 2025 Project Lotus sale-recapitalization of a national medical-outpatient portfolio. Fengate Asset Management invested through Fengate Infrastructure Fund IV and affiliated entities using FG MNTO I LOTUS, LLC, while Montecito Medical Real Estate retained equity; their percentages are not publicly disclosed. Fengate described 16 facilities in 10 states, while transaction-advisor and trade sources described 18 properties in 11 states totaling approximately 750,000 square feet and a US$323 million recapitalization with US$233 million of financing. The facilities were 100% leased at closing to health systems and physician groups. The record excludes Montecito's enterprise portfolio and Fengate's separate MedCraft/Cleveland Clinic portfolio. No later portfolio sale, owner exit or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
